skill.name: xiaohongshu-copywriter
skill.description: Generate Xiaohongshu product copy from product details and selling points, including three notes, titles, tags, and cover ideas.
skill.summary: Create Xiaohongshu-style product notes with titles, tags, and cover concepts.
skill.author: Hermes-Sedimentary

security_audit.summary: The static analyzer flagged high file entropy in SKILL.md, but manual review found a short Markdown skill with Chinese text, emoji, and front matter. No prompt injection, hidden instructions, network access, filesystem access, or code execution intent was found in the available file.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.35 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is plain Markdown front matter and Chinese usage text, with no binary payload, encrypted blob, or hidden executable content. The entropy heuristic is likely triggered by non-ASCII Chinese text and emoji.

content.value_statement: Writing Xiaohongshu posts takes time when product details are scattered. This skill turns product features and selling points into ready-to-review note drafts, titles, tags, and cover ideas.
actual_capabilities: Generates three complete Xiaohongshu-style note drafts from product and selling point input.
Suggests post titles for social commerce content.
Produces tag ideas for Xiaohongshu discovery.
Provides cover direction for each generated note.
Runs through plain conversation instructions in supported AI tools.
limitations: The skill does not publish posts or connect to Xiaohongshu APIs.
Outputs need human review for claims, compliance, and brand tone.
Quality depends on the product details and audience information supplied by the user.
The source does not document analytics, image generation, or trend verification.

use_cases.title: Launch Product Notes
use_cases.description: Create multiple Xiaohongshu drafts for a new product from features, audience, and selling points.

use_cases.title: Refresh Social Campaign Copy
use_cases.description: Generate new note angles, tags, and cover ideas for a planned content batch.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Review Drafts
use_cases.description: Produce structured drafts that a team can edit before legal, brand, or product review.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Basic Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the xiaohongshu-copywriter skill for a skincare serum. Audience: office workers age 25-35. Selling points: lightweight texture, quick absorption, fragrance-free. Create three notes with titles, tags, and cover ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Create Tone Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to write Xiaohongshu copy for a home coffee maker. Create three notes in practical, premium, and beginner-friendly tones. Include titles, tags, and cover ideas.

prompt_templates.title: Target a Campaign Segment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill for a summer travel backpack. Audience: weekend travelers in first-tier Chinese cities. Emphasize waterproof fabric, laptop storage, and light weight. Avoid exaggerated claims.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Review Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to create three Xiaohongshu notes for a new supplement brand. Include buyer pain points, compliant wording, title options, tags, cover concepts, and notes for human review.

output_examples.input: A fragrance-free sunscreen for sensitive skin, with light texture and daily commute use.
output: Title: 敏感肌通勤防晒这样选
Draft angle: Start with morning commute concerns, explain the light texture, then invite users to compare skin feel after lunch.
Tags: #敏感肌防晒 #通勤护肤 #清爽防晒
Cover idea: Show the tube beside a commuter bag and mirror.

output_examples.input: A compact home coffee maker for renters who want cafe-style drinks at home.
output: Title: 租房党也能做出咖啡店口感
Draft angle: Open with small kitchen space, then show simple daily use and easy cleaning.
Tags: #家用咖啡机 #租房好物 #咖啡日常
Cover idea: Place the machine on a small counter with a finished latte.

best_practices: Provide product facts, target audience, price range, and approved claims.
Ask for three different angles when you need a content batch.
Review every claim, tag, and cover idea before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent certifications, sales numbers, or medical effects.
Do not publish generated notes without brand and compliance review.
Do not use vague inputs such as only a product name.

faq.question: Does this skill publish to Xiaohongshu?
faq.answer: No. It creates draft copy, titles, tags, and cover ideas for manual review.

faq.question: Can it write in Chinese?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill description targets Xiaohongshu copy, which normally uses Chinese social content.

faq.question: How many drafts does it create?
faq.answer: The documented workflow creates three complete note drafts from product details and selling points.

faq.question: Does it generate images?
faq.answer: No evidence found that it generates images. It can suggest cover ideas based on the documented description.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is human review required?
faq.answer: Yes. The source notes that key outputs should be manually reviewed.
